item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00257","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C22","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.94,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C11 plausibly supplied concrete legal and administrative machinery for the child. Both assign the Bureau of the Budget leadership over executive-branch statistical and reporting practices, make reduction of burdens on information providers an express objective, require consultation with affected agencies, and authorize the Director to issue binding instructions. The child adapts that established framework specifically to unnecessary public paperwork and adds a progress-report deadline. C22 is a strong secondary letter-form analogue involving a Bureau-led government-wide improvement program, instructions, agency consultation, progress reporting, and recommendations, but it concerns federal manpower rather than reporting requirements. C06 supplies broader Bureau-led management-improvement machinery but is less specifically aligned with public reporting burdens.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"responsibilities for the improvement of government statistical activities ... already assigned to the Bureau of the Budget","parent_excerpt":"The Director of the Bureau of the Budget ... shall develop programs ... for the improved gathering, compiling, analyzing, publishing, and disseminating of statistical information","explanation":"Both place government-wide statistical improvement under Bureau of the Budget leadership."},{"child_excerpt":"give increased emphasis ... to the elimination of reporting requirements which impose unnecessary paperwork on the public","parent_excerpt":"To minimize the burden upon those furnishing statistical data needed by the various Federal agencies.","explanation":"The child's central objective closely restates C11's distinctive burden-minimization objective."},{"child_excerpt":"proceed with the development, in cooperation with the affected executive agencies, of plans for eliminating unnecessary public reporting requirements","parent_excerpt":"The Director ... shall ... make appropriate arrangements for improving statistical work involving relationships between two or more agencies, and ... assist the agencies ... to improve their statistical work.","explanation":"Both use interagency planning and assistance as the means of improving reporting or statistical practices."},{"child_excerpt":"consult freely with the affected Federal agencies ...
